_instructions: 1. Log in to Cloudflare Dashboard → your domain → Security → WAF
2. Create each rule below using 'Create rule'
3. Rules are evaluated in priority order (lower number = higher priority)

firewall_rules.name: Block non-Nigerian IPs from invoice submission
firewall_rules.description: Only allow invoice submission from Nigeria and whitelisted countries. Adjust as needed.
firewall_rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "/api/invoices/" and ip.geoip.country ne "NG" and ip.geoip.country ne "GB" and ip.geoip.country ne "US")
firewall_rules._note: Change 'challenge' to 'block' once you confirm your allowed countries

firewall_rules.name: Rate limit invoice submission
firewall_rules.description: Allow max 100 invoice submissions per minute per IP

firewall_rules.name: Block SQL injection attempts
firewall_rules.description: Block common SQL injection patterns in API requests
firewall_rules._note: Enable Cloudflare Managed Ruleset for SQL injection protection

firewall_rules.name: Require valid Authorization header on API
firewall_rules.description: Block API requests without Authorization header

firewall_rules.name: Block direct IP access
firewall_rules.description: Require requests to use domain name, not direct IP
firewall_rules._note: Replace yourdomain.com with your actual domain

firewall_rules.name: Allow health check without auth
firewall_rules.description: Whitelist health check endpoint from auth requirement

firewall_rules.name: DDoS protection on invoice endpoints
firewall_rules.description: Managed DDoS protection for invoice submission endpoints

dns_records._note: Proxied=true means traffic routes through Cloudflare (orange cloud)

managed_rulesets._note: Enable these in Security → WAF → Managed rules
